sentences.text:
This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application  and upon hearing the arguments of SHRI.PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocate for the  petitioners and of the PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondents 1&2 and of  the standing counsel for R3, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Admit.
Prosecutor take notice for R1 & R2.

Standing Counsel takes notice for R3.
Post after a month along with Crl.M.C. No.6042/2016 and connected cases.
Till then, further proceedings shall also stand stayed.
Sd/- DR. KAUSER EDAPPAGATH, JUDGE 14-07-2023
/True Copy/
